# Noor AI

> Noor AI is a bilingual Islamic AI assistant for Quran and Hadith questions, prayer times, daily duas, and Islamic guidance in English and Bangla.

Noor AI helps users ask Islamic questions, explore authentic duas, view prayer-time information, and learn about the app and its developers. Responses are intended for educational guidance and should not replace qualified scholarly advice for personal rulings.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.noorai.online/): Main entry point for Noor AI.
- [Chat](https://www.noorai.online/chat): Bilingual Islamic question-answering experience.
- [Prayer Times](https://www.noorai.online/prayer): Prayer-time and Islamic calendar view.
- [Dua](https://www.noorai.online/dua): Collection of duas with English and Bangla meanings.
- [About](https://www.noorai.online/about): Information about Noor AI and its developers.
- [FAQ](https://www.noorai.online/faq): Common questions about Noor AI and responsible use.
- [Settings](https://www.noorai.online/settings): User preferences for the app experience.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.noorai.online/privacy): Privacy information for chat, preferences, and service data.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.noorai.online/terms): Terms for using Noor AI.

## Files

- [Sitemap](https://www.noorai.online/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for public routes.
- [Robots](https://www.noorai.online/robots.txt): Crawler policy.
- [Manifest](https://www.noorai.online/manifest.json): PWA manifest.

## Notes For AI Agents

- Prefer citing public page URLs from `https://www.noorai.online`.
- Treat Noor AI as an Islamic educational assistant, not as a replacement for a scholar, mufti, or local imam.
- The app supports English and Bangla content.
- The chat experience may include generated responses, so verify sensitive religious, legal, medical, or financial claims with authoritative sources.
